name: Edco Industries/Plastic Injection Molding
old_description: The purpose of our mission statement is to provide direction and balance when committing a team of one or many to the growth and longevity of Edco Industries.
about:
Edco Industries operates from Bridgeport, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1978 as a family-owned and operated business. The company traces its roots to the Szalan family, with John T. Szalan, a plastics engineer and graduate of Central Connecticut State University, now serving as president after growing up in the business. His mother, Anna Marie Szalan, has overseen purchasing, accounting, quoting, and operations since the founding, providing more than 46 years of leadership.

The shop provides full-service injection molding, covering design collaboration, tooling construction using aluminum or steel molds, molding on state-of-the-art equipment, and a four-step quality inspection process. Secondary operations include hot stamping, ultrasonic welding, decorating, EMI coating, 3D printing, fastener application, and assembly. Production scales from low to high volumes, though the facility size and total headcount are not disclosed.

Edco serves a diverse range of industries with high-performance plastic components, but the company does not list specific sectors on its website. Its customer base includes businesses requiring ITAR-compliant manufacturing and those seeking HUBZone-certified suppliers.

The company’s stated differentiators are its ISO 9001:2015 certification, ITAR registration, SBA HUBZone certification, and recognition as a top woman-owned business in Connecticut. Its mission emphasizes superior quality, competitive pricing, on-time delivery, and 100 percent customer satisfaction as the foundation for profitability.
